_doc: KPI gates for Sub0Llm performance work. See docs/OPTIMIZATION_PROCESS.md for the policy these enforce. Shape borrowed from Sub0h264's docs/optimization/kpi_gates.json, which is the proven original.
_format: Each gate: id, label, stage, metric, op (gte|lte|eq), threshold, severity (hard|soft).
_severity: hard = must not land on main if it fails -- PARK behind a default-off constexpr toggle (docs/OPTIMIZATION_PROCESS.md S3), never revert. soft = tracked, warning only.
_noise_floor: Decode s/token on this host reproduces to +-1.5% at zero contention. Any |delta| < 2% is 'no measurable change'. Sub-floor wins are still kept and logged -- they are what compounds (S4).

gates.label: neutral-build decode fingerprint unchanged
gates._note: AGENTS.md S4. Proves the change did not leak into the default path. Re-baselined 2026-09-25 from 816c4a54ad49b8cf: the neutral config's tokenizer calibration changed (Codex, GSM8K calibration commit), which changes the vocabulary and so every fingerprint; confirmed by building main without any O5/O7 change. Companion hashes: forward 5a7382ea70d3913b, grad 7f44bdae18c313dd.

gates.label: sub0_tests assertion count
gates._note: Exact, or a delta fully attributable to tests this change added. An unattributable count change is an unexplained behaviour change.

gates.label: sub0_frontend_tests assertion count
gates._note: Grows as tests are added; must never shrink. 206818/292 as of the O7 merge (2026-09-25).

gates.label: forward vs forward_one bit-exact
gates._note: Waived ONLY for an arm that deliberately breaks it and says so at the toggle (currently --moe-quant-dot, which gives up op_moe-vs-decode agreement by design). B34 broke this accidentally and had to repair it.

gates.label: logit L2-relative vs the unfused path
gates._note: 0.43 is the FP8 precedent (B33/B37) -- the worst quality this project has been willing to ship even default-off. Reference points: BF16 0.199 @5/6 argmax (shipped default), B35 fused 0.2938 @4/6 (shipped default-off).

gates.label: no decode throughput regression beyond the noise floor
gates.metric: s/token vs the arm's own default
gates._note: Ratio, not absolute. 2% = the measured noise floor. Failing this means PARK, not revert.

gates.label: llama.cpp gap on the same host and model
gates._note: The external bar, not a blocker. B32 measured ~4-6x; post-B35 it is ~1.7-2.5x at the fused setting. Re-measure whenever an internal 'we are near the floor' argument is about to close down a line of work -- that is exactly the argument B32 falsified.
